Popdarts x PaddleSmash Giveaway Terms & Conditions

Promoters:

Popdarts
1985 Riviera Dr, STE 103-1038, Mount Pleasant, SC 29464
Email: support@popdartsgame.com
Privacy Policy: https://popdartsgame.com/policies/privacy-policy

PaddleSmash
Email: tim@paddlesmash.com
Terms of Use: https://paddlesmash.com/policies/terms-of-service

Giveaway Schedule
Start Date: July 1, 2025
End Date: July 31st, 2025
Winner Announcement: July 31st, 2025
Prize Claim Deadline: Winners must claim their prize within 48 hours of notification. If unclaimed, a new winner will be drawn.

Prizes

Pizza and drinks for 10 people
5 Pro Packs (Popdarts)
1 Tourney Board Set (Popdarts)
2 PaddleSmash Sets

How to Enter
To enter the giveaway, participants must:

Submit their email address using the official entry form.

Follow both @popdartsgame and @paddlesmash on instagram and tiktok.

Agree to sign up for marketing newsletters from both Popdarts and Paddlesmash.

Only one entry per person will be accepted. Duplicate entries will be disqualified.



Eligibility
Open to legal residents in the United States where Popdarts and PaddleSmash ship products.

Must be of legal age (18) in the jurisdiction of residence.

Employees of Popdarts, PaddleSmash, and their immediate families are not eligible to win.

Winner Selection
One winner will be randomly selected on July 31st, 2025.

Winners will be contacted via the email address provided during entry.

If a selected winner does not respond within 48 hours, an alternate winner will be chosen.

Prize Delivery
Prizes will be shipped directly to the winners at no cost.

Prizes are non-transferable, non-exchangeable, and not redeemable for cash.

Privacy and Communication
By entering, participants consent to receive marketing communications from both Popdarts and Spikeball.

Participant information will be handled in accordance with each promoter’s policy:

Popdarts Privacy Policy: https://popdartsgame.com/policies/privacy-policy

PaddleSmash Terms of Use: https://paddlesmash.com/policies/terms-of-service

General Conditions
The Promoters reserve the right to cancel, suspend, or modify the giveaway at any time for any reason.

The Promoters’ decisions regarding all aspects of the giveaway are final and binding.

The Promoters are not responsible for lost, delayed, misdirected, or incomplete entries due to technical or communication errors.

Disclaimer
This promotion is not sponsored, endorsed, or administered by, or associated with, Instagram, Facebook, or any other social platform. By entering, participants release these platforms from any and all liability related to the giveaway.
